title: Text: DET Bill Brown ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Anthony - Sorry.  I’m behind on reading the clips.  I shouldn’t be, though, because I’m still in Lakeland and unable to see any of the games unless they are on the MLB Network (all of them but the finale from Yankee Stadium).   I did notice in one of your articles the adjective “good” was used when the adverb “well” should have been.  I’ll try to find it and your use of “propensity”.  Remember, if you are describing a negative tendency, “proclivity” would be a better choice of words.  Thanks for thinking of me.  Let’s stay in touch. All the best.
